terminalDetail: turn/completed with turn.status=failed after the provider stream repeatedly returned 401 Unauthorized ('Missing bearer or basic authentication in header') for wss:// and https:// api.openai.com/v1/responses; the App Server retried 5 times per transport then failed the turn truthfully
appServerStderr: repeated: ERROR codex_api::endpoint::responses_websocket: failed to connect to websocket: HTTP error: 401 Unauthorized, url: wss://api.openai.com/v1/responses (7 occurrences, 08:59:21-08:59:32Z)
failureReasons: The clean CODEX_HOME contains no authentication material, so the model provider rejected every request with 401 Unauthorized; the turn started structurally (turn/started) but no model output, command item, or approval request could occur.
limitations: Approval-before-action and denial enforcement remain untested: the approval surface requires a model-driven command attempt, which requires authentication.
The real %USERPROFILE%\.codex was not read, copied, or modified, per probe rules — so no credentials were available to the clean home by design.
The outside target never existed at any checkpoint, but this proves nothing about denial enforcement since no action was ever proposed.

Testing approval denial under a clean home would require either an explicitly provisioned throwaway credential for the clean home or identifying/neutralizing the specific existing-home setting that breaks sandbox setup (see a2-clean-home-r2-result.json and a2-appserver-exec-result.json).
One App Server, one model turn, zero command attempts; server shut down cleanly on stdin EOF.
